correctness.rationale: Known Adamaszek–Adams theorem gives VR≤2(Q_n) ≃ wedge^{c_n} S³ for n≥3 with c_n=Σ_{j=0}^{n−3}2^j binom(j+3,3). The link of a cube vertex has precisely maximal cliques U, S_i, T_ij, V_ijk; a sequence of free-face collapses reduces the subcomplex B without V_ijk to simplex U, with each independent V_ijk 2-cell attached around its boundary. Hence link ≃ wedge^{binom n3} S² with integral V_ijk coordinates. If punctures have Hamming separation at least four, relative deleted-star cone-link chain groups split. Each 3-coordinate subcube through deleted p is an integral S³ whose relative 3-cycle hits the local V_ijk basis by ±1 and no other deleted point, making the global map H3(ambient)→H3(ambient,X_T) a split surjection. Long exact sequence gives primitive H3 rank c_n−|T|binom n3, no other reduced homology. Connectedness by two-coordinate detours, link simply-connected van Kampen, Hurewicz and Whitehead imply the full wedge homotopy type and natural intermediate primitive inclusions/cofibers. Independently enumerated all link maximal cliques n=3,4,5,6,7 with counts 8,15,26,42,64; matches exact U,S_i,T_ij,V_ijk formula. Finite tests do not establish universal homotopy.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not establish the universal theorem without the analytical/chain argument given; code proof obligations were reconstructed separately.
